entry_conditions: Supported entry is the late blue transport / release transition with drawer_position already above 0.26 m and red already on the outside pad. At the observed expanded-slice start around index 930, blue is grasped high near x -0.17 to -0.18 m, y 0.065 to 0.080 m, z about 0.32 m, the TCP is close to the blue block, and the fingers are closed at about 0.018 m per finger. The policy can also be entered later when causal observations show blue near the drawer z band, or after release when the gripper is opening and the TCP is retreating.
exit_conditions: Useful exit is the completed state: drawer_position > 0.26 m, red_pose centered on the outside pad near [-0.18, -0.30, 0.02] m, and blue_pose inside the open drawer cavity with z in approximately [0.053, 0.074] m. Demonstration exits additionally show open fingers near 0.04 m per finger and TCP retreated upward near z 0.323 m, separated above the settled blue block.
overlap_role: Indices 930-1030 are shared with blue_transport_to_drawer. In this overlap this policy learns the local handoff part of transport: maintain the grasp, center the blue block over the open drawer in the drawer/red/blue task frame, and descend from the high carry pose toward the release height. After the overlap it learns finger opening, upward TCP retreat, and the final settled hold.
successor_readiness: There is no required successor for the task. A monitor may stop when the supplied completion predicate is true at one observation. If a safety/settle behavior is desired, continue this policy briefly until the causal state also shows open fingers and TCP above the blue block rather than still pressing on it.
failure_signatures: Do not rely on this policy if the causal state shows drawer_position below the open threshold, red outside the pad, blue far outside the drawer-mouth neighborhood, or TCP/blue geometry inconsistent with the trained local transition. During execution, likely failure signatures are blue xy outside the drawer cavity bounds, blue z below 0.053 m or above 0.074 m at the intended completion instant, drawer closing below threshold, or the TCP remaining in contact with the blue block after finger opening and pushing it out of the cavity.
continuation_guidance: Continue through the shared descent while blue z is high and fingers are closed; continue through release when blue is at drawer height but the gripper has not opened or the TCP has not retreated. Transfer or terminate when the completion predicate is satisfied and, for handoff cleanliness, fingers are open with TCP above the object. The policy uses causal state cues only: qpos/finger width, qvel, TCP pose, red/blue poses, drawer position/velocity, and goal positions in world metres.
limitations: The handoff conditions describe observed support, not hard rejection thresholds or proof of grasp/contact. The policy is not trained to recover from arbitrary dropped-blue states or to reopen the drawer. Completion does not require release, clearance, velocity, or sustained hold, although release and retreat are retained because they are present in the demonstrated final interface.
